blocks.text: This Gift Letter is made on {{gift_date}} by {{donor_name}}, residing at {{donor_address}} ("Donor"), to {{recipient_name}}, residing at {{recipient_address}} ("Recipient").

I, {{donor_name}}, hereby confirm that I am the legal owner of the vehicle described above, free and clear of all liens and encumbrances. I hereby give, transfer, and donate the vehicle to {{recipient_name}} as a GIFT, without any monetary consideration. No money has been paid or will be paid by the Recipient to the Donor for this vehicle.
This is a bona fide gift. The transfer is not a sale, trade, or exchange for value.

items: Donor is the legal owner of the Vehicle and has full authority to gift it.
The Vehicle is free of all liens and encumbrances. No loan or lien is outstanding.
Donor has not previously sold, offered to sell, or contracted to sell the Vehicle to any person.
Donor has disclosed all known material defects to Recipient.
Donor makes no warranties regarding the Vehicle's condition. The Vehicle is transferred "as-is."
The gift is not conditional on any obligation of the Recipient.

blocks.text: This gift may be subject to gift tax reporting requirements. Donor should consult a tax professional. Estimated fair market value at time of gift: {{estimated_fair_market_value}}. This Gift Letter does not constitute tax advice.
Donor certifies that the statements in this Gift Letter are true and correct to the best of Donor's knowledge.

items: Receiving the Vehicle as a gift with no monetary consideration.
Understanding that the Vehicle is transferred "as-is" with no warranties.
Accepting responsibility for all future costs, taxes, registration, insurance, and liabilities associated with ownership.
Understanding that the DMV may require additional forms, taxes, or fees to complete the title transfer.

blocks.text: Note: This Gift Letter does not transfer title. The title must be properly assigned and submitted to the DMV, along with any required gift tax forms, odometer disclosure, and registration application.
